celaleyn:1-1.t: ﴿ق﴾ Allah knows best what He means by it.

celaleyn:2-2.t: ﴿وَالْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِيدِ﴾ the noble: the disbelievers of Mecca did not believe in Muhammad ﷺ ﴿بَلْ عَجِبُوا أَنْ جَاءَهُمْ مُنْذِرٌ مِنْهُمْ﴾ a messenger from among themselves making them fear the Fire after the resurrection ﴿فَقَالَ الْكَافِرُونَ هَذَا﴾ warning ﴿شَيْءٌ عَجِيبٌ﴾

celaleyn:3-3.t: ﴿أَإِذَا﴾ with both hamzas fully pronounced (taḥqīq), and with lightening (tashīl) of the second, and with an alif inserted between them in both ways ﴿مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا﴾ shall we return? ﴿ذَلِكَ رَجْعٌ بَعِيدٌ﴾ extremely far-fetched.

celaleyn:4-4.t: ﴿قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنْقُصُ الْأَرْضُ﴾ eats ﴿مِنْهُمْ وَعِنْدَنَا كِتَابٌ حَفِيظٌ﴾ it is the Preserved Tablet, in which are all things decreed.

celaleyn:5-5.t: ﴿بَلْ كَذَّبُوا بِالْحَقِّ﴾ the Quran ﴿لَمَّا جَاءَهُمْ فَهُمْ﴾ concerning the Prophet ﷺ and the Quran ﴿فِي أَمْرٍ مَرِيجٍ﴾ confused: once they said "a sorcerer" and "sorcery", once "a poet" and "poetry", and once "a soothsayer" and "soothsaying".

celaleyn:6-6.t: ﴿أَفَلَمْ يَنْظُرُوا﴾ with their eyes, taking a lesson with their minds, when they denied the resurrection ﴿إِلَى السَّمَاءِ﴾ being ﴿فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَاهَا﴾ without pillars ﴿وَزَيَّنَّاهَا﴾ with the stars ﴿وَمَا لَهَا مِنْ فُرُوجٍ﴾ cracks that would mar it.

celaleyn:7-7.t: ﴿وَالْأَرْضَ﴾ conjoined to the position of «إِلَى السَّمَاءِ»; how ﴿مَدَدْنَاهَا﴾ We spread it out on the surface of the water ﴿وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَاسِيَ﴾ mountains that make it firm ﴿وَأَنْبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِنْ كُلِّ زَوْجٍ﴾ kind ﴿بَهِيجٍ﴾ which delights because of its beauty.

celaleyn:8-8.t: ﴿تَبْصِرَةً﴾ a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose), i.e. We did that as an enlightening from Us ﴿وَذِكْرَى﴾ a reminding ﴿لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍ مُنِيبٍ﴾ who returns often to obedience to Us.

celaleyn:9-9.t: ﴿وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ السَّمَاءِ مَاءً مُبَارَكًا﴾ of abundant blessing ﴿فَأَنْبَتْنَا بِهِ جَنَّاتٍ﴾ orchards ﴿وَحَبَّ﴾ of the crop ﴿الْحَصِيدِ﴾ that is harvested.

celaleyn:10-10.t: ﴿وَالنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَاتٍ﴾ tall; an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara) ﴿لَهَا طَلْعٌ نَضِيدٌ﴾ piled one upon another.

celaleyn:11-11.t: ﴿رِزْقًا لِلْعِبَادِ﴾ a mafʿūl lahu (object of purpose) ﴿وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِ بَلْدَةً مَيْتًا﴾ in which the masculine and the feminine are alike ﴿كَذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. like this giving of life ﴿الْخُرُوجُ﴾ from the graves; so how can you deny it? The interrogative is for affirmation (taqrīr), and the meaning is that they looked and knew what has been mentioned.

celaleyn:12-12.t: ﴿كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ﴾ the verb is feminine because of the meaning of «قَوْم» ﴿وَأَصْحَابُ الرَّسِّ﴾ it is a well at which they stayed with their livestock, worshipping idols; their prophet, it is said, was Ḥanẓala ibn Ṣafwān, and it is said someone else ﴿وَثَمُودُ﴾ the people of Ṣāliḥ

celaleyn:13-13.t: ﴿وَعَادٌ﴾ the people of Hūd ﴿وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَانُ لُوطٍ﴾

celaleyn:14-14.t: ﴿وَأَصْحَابُ الْأَيْكَةِ﴾ i.e. the thicket; the people of Shuʿayb ﴿وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍ﴾ he was a king in Yemen who became Muslim and called his people to Islam, and they denied him ﴿كُلٌّ﴾ of those mentioned ﴿كَذَّبَ الرُّسُلَ﴾ like Quraysh ﴿فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ﴾ the descent of the punishment upon all became binding, so let not your breast be constricted by the disbelief of Quraysh in you.

celaleyn:15-15.t: ﴿أَفَعَيِينَا بِالْخَلْقِ الْأَوَّلِ﴾ i.e. We were not wearied by it, so We will not be wearied by the repetition ﴿بَلْ هُمْ فِي لَبْسٍ﴾ doubt ﴿مِنْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍ﴾ and it is the resurrection.

celaleyn:16-16.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسَانَ وَنَعْلَمُ﴾ a ḥāl (circumstantial), with «نَحْنُ» implied ﴿مَا﴾ maṣdariyya (infinitival) ﴿تُوَسْوِسُ﴾ speaks ﴿بِهِ﴾ the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) or for making the verb transitive, and the pronoun refers to man ﴿نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ﴾ in knowledge ﴿مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ﴾ the genitive construct is explicative (bayān); the two warīds are two veins on the two sides of the neck.

celaleyn:17-17.t: ﴿إِذْ﴾ what puts it in the accusative is an implied «اذْكُرْ» (remember) ﴿يَتَلَقَّى﴾ takes and records ﴿الْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ﴾ the two angels assigned to man, what he does ﴿عَنِ الْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ الشِّمَالِ﴾ of him ﴿قَعِيدٌ﴾ i.e. two sitting ones; it is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is what precedes it.

celaleyn:18-18.t: ﴿مَا يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ﴾ a guardian ﴿عَتِيدٌ﴾ present; and each of them has the meaning of the dual.

celaleyn:19-19.t: ﴿وَجَاءَتْ سَكْرَةُ الْمَوْتِ﴾ its overwhelming and its severity ﴿بِالْحَقِّ﴾ of the matter of the Hereafter, so that the one who denied it sees it with his own eyes; and it is the severity itself ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. death ﴿مَا كُنْتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ﴾ flee and take fright.

celaleyn:20-20.t: ﴿وَنُفِخَ فِي الصُّورِ﴾ for the resurrection ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the day of the blowing ﴿يَوْمُ الْوَعِيدِ﴾ for the disbelievers, with punishment.

celaleyn:21-21.t: ﴿وَجَاءَتْ﴾ on it ﴿كُلُّ نَفْسٍ﴾ to the place of gathering ﴿مَعَهَا سَائِقٌ﴾ an angel who drives it there ﴿وَشَهِيدٌ﴾ who testifies against it regarding its deeds, and it is the hands, the feet and others; and it will be said to the disbeliever:

celaleyn:22-22.t: ﴿لَقَدْ كُنْتَ﴾ in this world ﴿فِي غَفْلَةٍ مِنْ هَذَا﴾ which descends on you today ﴿فَكَشَفْنَا عَنْكَ غِطَاءَكَ﴾ We removed your heedlessness by what you witness today ﴿فَبَصَرُكَ الْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌ﴾ sharp, by which you perceive what you denied in this world.

celaleyn:23-23.t: ﴿وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُ﴾ the angel assigned to him ﴿هَذَا مَا﴾ i.e. that which ﴿لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ﴾ present; then it will be said to Mālik:

celaleyn:24-24.t: ﴿أَلْقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ﴾ i.e. «أَلْقِ أَلْقِ» ("throw, throw"), or «أَلْقِيَنْ», and al-Ḥasan read it so; the nūn was then changed into an alif ﴿كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍ﴾ obstinate against the truth

celaleyn:25-25.t: ﴿مَنَّاعٍ لِلْخَيْرِ﴾ such as zakat ﴿مُعْتَدٍ﴾ unjust ﴿مُرِيبٍ﴾ doubting his religion

celaleyn:26-26.t: ﴿الَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ اللَّهِ إِلَهًا آخَرَ﴾ a mubtadaʾ (subject) made to include the meaning of a condition; its khabar (predicate) is ﴿فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِي الْعَذَابِ الشَّدِيدِ﴾ its explanation is like what has preceded.

celaleyn:27-27.t: ﴿قَالَ قَرِينُهُ﴾ the devil ﴿رَبَّنَا مَا أَطْغَيْتُهُ﴾ I did not lead him astray ﴿وَلَكِنْ كَانَ فِي ضَلَالٍ بَعِيدٍ﴾ so I called him and he answered me; and he [the man] said: "He led me astray by calling me."

celaleyn:28-28.t: ﴿قَالَ﴾ He, Exalted is He ﴿لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا لَدَيَّ﴾ i.e. disputing is of no benefit here ﴿وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُمْ﴾ in this world ﴿بِالْوَعِيدِ﴾ with punishment in the Hereafter if you did not believe, and it is inevitable.

celaleyn:29-29.t: ﴿مَا يُبَدَّلُ﴾ is changed ﴿الْقَوْلُ لَدَيَّ﴾ in that ﴿وَمَا أَنَا بِظَلَّامٍ لِلْعَبِيدِ﴾ so as to punish them without a crime; «ظَلَّام» is in the meaning of «ذُو ظُلْم» (one possessing injustice), because of His saying {لَا ظُلْمَ الْيَوْمَ}.

celaleyn:30-30.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ what puts it in the accusative is «ظَلَّام» ﴿نَقُولُ﴾ with nūn and with yāʾ ﴿لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ امْتَلَأْتِ﴾ an interrogative confirming His promise to fill it ﴿وَتَقُولُ﴾ in the form of an interrogative, like a question ﴿هَلْ مِنْ مَزِيدٍ﴾ i.e. in me; I cannot hold more than what I have been filled with, i.e. I am already full.

celaleyn:31-31.t: ﴿وَأُزْلِفَتِ الْجَنَّةُ﴾ was brought near ﴿لِلْمُتَّقِينَ﴾ to a place ﴿غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ﴾ from them, so they see it, and it will be said to them:

celaleyn:32-32.t: ﴿هَذَا﴾ which is seen ﴿مَا تُوعَدُونَ﴾ with tāʾ and with yāʾ, in this world; and His saying ﴿لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ﴾ is a badal (substitute) of «لِلْمُتَّقِينَ»; one who returns often to obedience to Allah ﴿حَفِيظٍ﴾ who guards His limits

celaleyn:33-33.t: ﴿مَنْ خَشِيَ الرَّحْمَنَ بِالْغَيْبِ﴾ feared Him without having seen Him ﴿وَجَاءَ بِقَلْبٍ مُنِيبٍ﴾ turning to His obedience; and it will also be said to the God-fearing:

celaleyn:34-34.t: ﴿ادْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَامٍ﴾ i.e. safe from every fear, or with peace, i.e. give greetings of peace and enter ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ the day on which the entry took place ﴿يَوْمُ الْخُلُودِ﴾ permanence in the Garden.

celaleyn:35-35.t: ﴿لَهُمْ مَا يَشَاءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ﴾ an addition beyond what they did and asked for.

celaleyn:36-36.t: ﴿وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُمْ مِنْ قَرْنٍ﴾ i.e. We destroyed before the disbelievers of Quraysh many generations of disbelievers ﴿هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ بَطْشًا﴾ in strength ﴿فَنَقَّبُوا﴾ they searched ﴿فِي الْبِلَادِ هَلْ مِنْ مَحِيصٍ﴾ for them or for others from death; and they found none.

celaleyn:37-37.t: ﴿إِنَّ فِي ذَلِكَ﴾ mentioned ﴿لَذِكْرَى﴾ an admonition ﴿لِمَنْ كَانَ لَهُ قَلْبٌ﴾ a mind ﴿أَوْ أَلْقَى السَّمْعَ﴾ listened to the admonition ﴿وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ﴾ present with the heart.

celaleyn:38-38.t: ﴿وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ﴾ the first of them Sunday and the last Friday ﴿وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِنْ لُغُوبٍ﴾ weariness. It was revealed as a rebuttal of the Jews in their saying that Allah rested on Saturday. Weariness is negated of Him because He, Exalted is He, is far above the attributes of created beings, and because there is no contact between Him and anything else: {إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَيْئًا أَنْ يَقُولَ لَهُ كُنْ فَيَكُونُ}

celaleyn:39-39.t: ﴿فَاصْبِرْ﴾ addressed to the Prophet ﷺ ﴿عَلَى مَا يَقُولُونَ﴾ i.e. the Jews and others, of likening [Allah to creation] and denial ﴿وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ﴾ pray, praising ﴿قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ﴾ i.e. the dawn prayer ﴿وَقَبْلَ الْغُرُوبِ﴾ i.e. the noon and afternoon prayers.

celaleyn:40-40.t: ﴿وَمِنَ اللَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ﴾ i.e. pray the two night prayers (al-ʿishāʾān) ﴿وَأَدْبَارَ السُّجُودِ﴾ with fatḥa on the hamza, the plural of «دُبُر», and with kasra on it [إِدْبَارَ], the maṣdar (verbal noun) of «أَدْبَرَ»; i.e. pray the recommended voluntary prayers after the obligatory ones. And it is said: what is meant is actual glorification (tasbīḥ) at these times, accompanied by praise.

celaleyn:41-41.t: ﴿وَاسْتَمِعْ﴾ O you addressed, to what I say ﴿يَوْمَ يُنَادِ الْمُنَادِ﴾ he is Isrāfīl ﴿مِنْ مَكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ﴾ to the sky, and it is the Rock of Jerusalem (Bayt al-Maqdis), the place on earth nearest to the sky. He will say: "O decayed bones, severed joints, torn flesh and scattered hairs! Allah commands you to gather together for the final judgement."

celaleyn:42-42.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of «يَوْمَ» before it ﴿يَسْمَعُونَ﴾ i.e. all creatures ﴿الصَّيْحَةَ بِالْحَقِّ﴾ with the resurrection, and it is the second blowing by Isrāfīl; and it may be before his call or after it ﴿ذَلِكَ﴾ i.e. the day of the calling and the hearing ﴿يَوْمُ الْخُرُوجِ﴾ from the graves. What puts «يَوْمَ يُنَادِي» in the accusative is implied, i.e. «يَعْلَمُونَ عَاقِبَةَ تَكْذِيبِهِمْ» ("they will know the outcome of their denial").

celaleyn:43-43.t: ﴿إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْيِي وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا الْمَصِيرُ﴾ [Translator's note: al-Jalalayn gives no explanation here.]

celaleyn:44-44.t: ﴿يَوْمَ﴾ a badal (substitute) of «يَوْمَ» before it, and what is between them is parenthetical ﴿تَشَقَّقُ﴾ with the shīn light and doubled, by assimilating the second tāʾ of the underlying form into it ﴿الْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا﴾ the plural of «سَرِيع»; a ḥāl (circumstantial) from something implied, i.e. «فَيَخْرُجُونَ مُسْرِعِينَ» ("so they come out hastening") ﴿ذَلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ﴾ in it the described noun and its adjective are separated by what the adjective is attached to, for specification (ikhtiṣāṣ), and that does no harm. «ذَلِكَ» points to the meaning of the gathering that is reported about it, namely giving life after annihilation and the gathering for presentation and reckoning.

celaleyn:45-45.t: ﴿نَحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ﴾ i.e. the disbelievers of Quraysh ﴿وَمَا أَنْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ بِجَبَّارٍ﴾ to compel them to believe; and this was before the command for jihad ﴿فَذَكِّرْ بِالْقُرْآنِ مَنْ يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ﴾ and they are the believers.
